messages:
kevin: Scheduling Luminary AI dedicated rollout — target window Wed Apr 12 00:30-02:30 UTC. Plan is to pin inference-service to v2.3.1 with a 10% canary slice. Need sign-off on window, rollback thresholds, and KMS collision risk.
maya: Sounds OK. Please paste a short release-notes summary here. Also FYI we may need to nudge 30m earlier if infra has overlapping maintenance.
deploybot: @kevin I can schedule the job once you confirm full args. Example: `/deploy start --customer=luminary-ai --env=dedicated --version=v2.3.1 --canary=10% --window=2026-04-12T00:30Z/2026-04-12T02:30Z --fallback=v2.2.9`
ana: SRE note — there is a KMS rotation in eu-west-1 at Apr 12 03:00 UTC (internal maintenance). Luminary uses a customer-managed key in their VPC for some tenant volumes; we should avoid any overlap with their key rotation window. Can we confirm whether the rollout touches that region or the customer KMS?
kevin: Luminary is in us-west-2 primary but private replicas in eu-west-1 will be reconfigured. They asked to avoid 02:50-03:20 UTC. Proposed move to 00:30-02:30 avoids the 03:00 KMS collision. Fallback variant will be v2.2.9 (quantized). Canaries should not trigger KMS ops.
chris: Release notes (short):
- inference-service v2.3.1: improved kernel selection for long-context models
- kv-cache hotfix: fixes stale-prefix invalidation (reduces cold-starts)
- telemetry: private deployments default to opt-in; added opt-out toggle in tenant console
- minor tokenizer and detokenization bugfixes
(I'll paste these to tenant portal after we lock the window)
maya: Canary monitoring/rollback proposal — monitor these metrics on the canary slice: p95 latency, token error rate (HTTP 5xx / generation errors), and node OOMs. Automatic rollback triggers: 
- p95 latency > 700ms for a sustained 5 minutes
- token error rate >= 2% for 3 consecutive minutes
- any memory OOM > 1 per node in 2m window
If auto-rollback happens, deploybot should immediately failover canary to fallback v2.2.9 and notify Luminary and SRE.
kevin: Add circuit-breaker: if canary fails, do not continue rollout. Also require a manual approve to promote to 100%. Who approves the final promote? maya or luminary PM?
maya: I will approve promotion after canary clears for 30m and no regressions in eval set. Luminary PM wants an in-window postmortem if anything happens.
kevin: Manual deploy command (for runbook):
```
/deploy start --customer=luminary-ai --env=dedicated \
  --version=v2.3.1 --canary=10% \
  --window=2026-04-12T00:30Z/2026-04-12T02:30Z \
  --fallback=v2.2.9 --pin-version
```
And manual rollback snippet: 
```
/deploy rollback --customer=luminary-ai --to-version=v2.2.9 \
  --reason=\"canary-threshold\" --force
# or via kubectl (private plane):
kubectl -n luminary rollout undo deployment/inference-service --to-revision=stable-v2.2.9
```
deploybot: Dry-run completed OK. To lock and schedule the rollout run `/deploy approve 4168509123` (will record approver). Once approved I'll post canary start/finish messages and metrics links.
maya: /deploy approve 4168509123
deploybot: Approval recorded: maya. Canary scheduled: 2026-04-12T00:35Z (job id jb-71624). Will post status pings to this thread. I created a temporary dashboard: https://grafana.internal/redwood/luminary-canary
kevin: :thumbsup:
ana: SRE-oncall assigned — I'll watch alerts. I've set Grafana alerts: p95>700ms, error-rate>1.5% warn / 2% critical, memory OOM critical. Pager duty set to on-call team.
sre-oncall: Oncall here — ACK. I'll be available in the window and will escalate to eng-run if we hit rollback criteria.
chris: I'll upload the short release notes to tenant portal and add a line item to the customer bulletin: https://console.redwood/tenants/luminary/releases
kevin: Thanks all. Final check: no other infra maints overlapping? maya, confirm once more and we'll handoff to deploybot to run the canary.
maya: Confirmed from infra. No collisions. Proceed.
deploybot: Job jb-71624 scheduled for 2026-04-12T00:35Z. This thread will receive: canary:start, canary:metrics (5m cadence), canary:finish, and any rollback events. Last scheduled update id 786912. Good luck!
